thought.text: Yarn 4.13.0 is active. Let me persist the PATH and check the Ruby build progress.

reasoning_content: Yarn 4.13.0 is now enabled via corepack. Let me check the Ruby build progress and also set up the shell profile so PATH persists across commands.

action.command:

echo "=== ruby build status ==="; cat /tmp/ruby_build.done 2>/dev/null || echo "still building"
